behavioral_notes.observation: iap.account is the local stub of a remote prepaid wallet, one row per IAP service (service_id->iap.service, service_name=service_id.technical_name). Its identity is account_token: a uuid4().hex (size 43, copy=False) restricted to base.group_system that is the authentication key sent on every outbound IAP call. balance and state ('banned'/'registered'/'unregistered') are NOT stored locally — they are declared readonly and refreshed on demand: web_read() calls _get_account_information_from_iap() before every form/list read, POSTing each token+technical_name plus database.uuid to '/iap/1/get-accounts-information' on the IAP endpoint, then writing back balance (rounded 4dp unless service.integer_balance) and warning_threshold under context disable_iap_update+tracking_disable. company_ids scopes an account to companies (ir.rule restricts users to their own companies). On create, if database.is_neutralized the token is suffixed '+disabled' so a copied/neutralized DB can never spend real credits; neutralize.sql does the same in bulk.

behavioral_notes.element: iap_tools.iap_jsonrpc + iap_get_endpoint (the single outbound HTTP broker)
behavioral_notes.observation: tools/iap_tools.iap_jsonrpc(url, method='call', params, timeout=15) is the ONE place the whole framework reaches the public internet: it builds a JSON-RPC 2.0 envelope and does requests.post(url, json=payload), raise_for_status(), then unwraps response['result']. Server-side errors are mapped to typed Python exceptions: a JSON-RPC error whose data.name ends in 'InsufficientCreditError' becomes iap_tools.InsufficientCreditError (carrying .data with credit/service_name/base_url so callers can prompt a top-up), anything else becomes IAPServerError, and requests timeouts/RequestExceptions become odoo.exceptions.AccessError. The target host is resolved by iap_get_endpoint(env) = ir.config_parameter 'iap.endpoint' (DEFAULT_ENDPOINT 'https://iap.odoo.com'), so a self-hosted/proxy IAP server is a one-parameter override. Crucially, if modules.module.current_test is set, iap_jsonrpc immediately raises AccessError('Unavailable during tests.') — the framework is hard-wired to never bill or hit the network in test runs.

Two credit-facing helpers consumed across the suite. get_credits(service_name) resolves the account (force_create=False) and POSTs token+dbuuid to '/iap/1/balance', returning the integer credit count (or -1 on AccessError) — the canonical 'do I have enough?' probe before a paid feature runs. get_credits_url(service_name, account_token) builds the buy-more deep-link to '<endpoint>/iap/1/credit' with dbuuid, service_name and a SHA1-hashed token (_hash_iap_token, hashed=1) so the raw secret never leaves in a URL; action_buy_credits returns it as an ir.actions.act_url and the OWL widget surfaces it. account.get(service_name, force_create=True) is the lazy provisioning entry point: it searches by company scope, garbage-collects tokenless rows on a separate cursor, and on first use creates the account on a fresh pool.cursor() because the very first paid call typically rolls back the main cursor with InsufficientCreditError/NoCreditError.

behavioral_notes.element: iap.enrich.api -> iap-services.odoo.com (a brokered downstream service example)
behavioral_notes.observation: iap.enrich.api (AbstractModel, no fields) is a thin facade over a specific paid endpoint and shows the broker pattern other modules follow: _contact_iap(local_endpoint, params) fetches the 'reveal' account, injects account_token + database.uuid into params, resolves base_url from ir.config_parameter 'enrich.endpoint' (its own _DEFAULT_ENDPOINT 'https://iap-services.odoo.com', distinct from the credit host), and calls iap_jsonrpc(timeout=300). _request_enrich(lead_emails) hits '/iap/clearbit/1/lead_enrichment_email' and documents that the server may answer with InsufficientCreditError. The 'reveal' service itself is seeded by data/services.xml (iap.service technical_name='reveal') so dependent apps (crm/partner_autocomplete) can find an account before any UI exists.

1 HTTP call site; SDKs ['requests']; api_keys=False (auth is the per-account token, not a global API key). Endpoints: https://iap.odoo.com (credits/balance/accounts-information/warning-alerts), https://iap-services.odoo.com (enrichment), https://iap.odoo.com/iap/1/credit (buy URL). This module is the egress chokepoint that brokers ALL IAP traffic for the database; every dependent feature (sms, snailmail, partner_autocomplete, lead mining, ocr...) routes its paid calls through iap_jsonrpc here.

1 JS file, 1 OWL component, 1 registry add; bundles ['web.assets_backend']. IAPActionButtonsWidget is a view_widget ('iap_buy_more_credits') with onManageServiceLinkClicked (orm.silent.call iap.account.get_account_id -> open the account form) and onViewServicesClicked (doAction iap.iap_account_action) — host modules drop it on their settings/config views to expose 'Manage Service & Buy Credits' / 'View My Services'.

it_architecture.application: iap (In-App Purchase framework: credit-account plumbing + outbound JSON-RPC broker to Odoo IAP services)
information_flows: outbound: iap_tools.iap_jsonrpc -> requests.post -> IAP endpoint (iap.endpoint param, default https://iap.odoo.com)
credit-check: get_credits -> POST /iap/1/balance ; top-up: get_credits_url/action_buy_credits -> act_url to /iap/1/credit (SHA1-hashed token)
error-up: InsufficientCreditError / IAPServerError / AccessError propagated to caller modules to gate paid features
consumed-by (downstream): sms, snailmail, partner_autocomplete, crm lead mining/enrichment, ocr and other paid features call iap.account.get + iap_jsonrpc
frontend_components: IAPActionButtonsWidget (view_widget 'iap_buy_more_credits': Manage Service & Buy Credits / View My Services)

capabilities: Broker paid calls to external Odoo IAP services (single outbound JSON-RPC gateway)
Provision & hold per-service prepaid credit accounts (iap.account wallet + account_token)
Check remaining credit balance and gate paid features (get_credits / InsufficientCreditError)
Provide a buy-more-credits / top-up deep-link into the Odoo IAP portal
Synchronise account balance & registration state from the IAP server
Notify owners on low credit (warning_threshold + email alert recipients)
value_streams: Provision-to-Spend: dependent feature calls iap.account.get(service) -> account+token -> iap_jsonrpc to IAP server -> result or InsufficientCreditError
Low-credit-to-Top-up: balance sync / InsufficientCreditError -> get_credits_url -> act_url -> Odoo IAP buy portal -> recharged balance
policies: 1 record rule: users see only iap.account rows for their own companies (or company-less)
account_token field restricted to base.group_system; managers (group_system) CRUD accounts, users may read/create only
neutralized/duplicated DB -> account_token suffixed '+disabled' (create() + neutralize.sql) so credits cannot be spent
module.current_test -> iap_jsonrpc raises AccessError: never bills or hits the network in tests
stakeholders: End user of a paid feature (SMS send, lead enrich, snailmail, partner autocomplete) consuming credits
System administrator / IAP account manager (base.group_system: manages accounts, tokens, buys credits)
Dependent module developer (calls iap.account.get + iap_tools.iap_jsonrpc to add a paid feature)
Odoo S.A. IAP platform (external vendor operating iap.odoo.com / iap-services.odoo.com)
metrics: Credit balance per account (iap.account.balance, synced from server)
warning_threshold low-credit alert level (email alert to warning_user_ids)

classification.rationale: iap is shared firm IT infrastructure (Porter support activity; Stabell & Fjeldstad 'support'). It owns no business object of its own value chain/shop/network — it is the credit-account plumbing and the single outbound JSON-RPC broker (iap_tools.iap_jsonrpc) through which MANY other modules (sms, snailmail, partner_autocomplete, crm lead mining/enrichment, ocr) reach Odoo's external paid IAP services. auto_install=true and category Hidden/Tools confirm it is ubiquitous, invisible plumbing, not a user-facing app; with only 3 models, 0 routes and ~723 py LOC its substance is the external HTTP integration (gap #7) plus the credit wallet, not data-bearing transactions. APQC 8.0 'Manage Information Technology' fits because the work is managing external IT services / vendor connectivity (provision accounts, broker calls, meter credits, manage the IAP endpoint configuration) — i.e. 8.x 'manage IT services / external service providers'. 9.0 'Acquire, Construct and Manage Assets' and 13.0 'Develop and Manage Business Capabilities' were considered: the credit purchase has a faint procurement flavour, but there is no purchase.order/account.move/asset object here — iap only mints a top-up URL and meters a remote prepaid balance; the actual capability is technical vendor-connectivity, which is squarely IT-services management (8.0).

standard_capabilities: Per-service prepaid credit account (iap.account) with secret account_token authentication
Single outbound JSON-RPC broker to the Odoo IAP endpoint with typed credit/server/access errors
Configurable IAP endpoint via ir.config_parameter 'iap.endpoint' (self-hosted/proxy capable)
On-demand balance & registration-state sync from the IAP server
Buy-more-credits deep-link (hashed token) + 'iap_buy_more_credits' OWL view widget for host views
Multi-company account scoping via record rule
Lazy account provisioning (iap.account.get) used by all dependent paid features
typical_fits: Any app that wants a metered paid call: declare an iap.service, call iap.account.get(service) then iap_tools.iap_jsonrpc
Embedding 'Manage Service & Buy Credits' on a module's settings view via the iap_buy_more_credits widget
Pointing the whole database at a private IAP proxy by setting the iap.endpoint system parameter
common_gaps: No local ledger of consumption/spend history — billing/metering lives on the external IAP server (gap #7)
No authorize/capture two-phase charge in this version: a paid call is a single iap_jsonrpc that the server answers with InsufficientCreditError; per-credit accounting is the caller's responsibility
Requires outbound HTTPS to iap.odoo.com / iap-services.odoo.com; air-gapped deployments need a self-hosted IAP endpoint
No in-app credit purchase/checkout — top-up is a redirect to the external Odoo IAP portal
Tests cannot exercise real calls (iap_jsonrpc hard-fails under module.current_test)
drive_hints: odoo shell: env['iap.account'].get('reveal').sudo().account_token  # lazily provision + read the per-service token
odoo shell: env['iap.account'].get_credits_url('reveal')  # buy-more deep link (note hashed=1, no raw token)
odoo shell: from odoo.addons.iap.tools import iap_tools; iap_tools.iap_get_endpoint(env)  # resolved endpoint

curl -s -X POST https://iap.odoo.com/iap/1/balance -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"call","params":{"dbuuid":"<uuid>","account_token":"<token>","service_name":"reveal"}}'  # the live balance probe iap does

open_questions: Full catalogue of downstream consumer modules and which iap.service each registers (sms, snailmail, partner_autocomplete, crm lead mining/enrichment, ocr...) — not declared inside iap itself.
Server-side credit metering / per-call pricing lives on iap.odoo.com and is not reverse-engineerable from this module (gap #7).
Whether deployments override iap.endpoint / enrich.endpoint to a private IAP proxy (runtime config, not in code).
